title: Map operation event request
description: POST /map-events body only. Existing allowlist; UUID normalization, timezone parsing and raw byte limits remain server checks. Custom IMG operations are excluded.

schemaVersion.description: Current server compares with 1 and also accepts true; this documents existing behavior without changing validation.

id.description: Random UUID accepted and normalized by Python UUID; no physical device identifier.

operationId.description: Random UUID linking map events within an operation; no persistent device identity.

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp parsed by datetime.fromisoformat; timezone required.
